answer:

title: Trap #15: Mule Event Immutability Under Project Reactor
answer:
❌ Common Interview Trap: You can mutate the incoming Mule Event object directly in-place across processors.
✅ Senior Architect Correction: The Mule 4 Event is strictly immutable for thread-safe reactive execution. Every processor (Set Payload, Set Variable, Transform) yields a new Mule Event instance rather than mutating shared memory across async threads.

title: Trap #16: HTTP Request Connector vs Exchange REST Connectors
answer:

✅ Senior Architect Correction: The core HTTP Request Connector calls any REST/HTTP endpoint directly with full control over pooling, timeouts, streaming, and mTLS. title: Trap #17: Securing Credentials with ${secure::...} Syntax
